exploitability.conclusion: No unprivileged profitable path found on any of the five vaults. Donations only raise the share price and are net losses for the donor; deposit/withdraw rounding favors the vault; no reentrancy hooks; wUSDB holds 0 assets and its admin/role functions are gated.
exploitability.donation_math: Donating X to a vault with totalAssets T raises price by (T+X)/T; attacker net = +X*a - X = -X*(1-a) where a<1 is attacker share fraction -> strictly negative
